changeSet.sql: UPDATE histogram_chart_configuration hc SET min_bin = ( SELECT (hb.lower_bound + hb.upper_bound) / 2 FROM histogram_bin hb WHERE hb.histogram_chart_configuration_id = hc.id ORDER BY hb.lower_bound ASC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE hc.binning_mode = 'MANUAL'; UPDATE histogram_chart_configuration hc SET max_bin = ( SELECT (hb.lower_bound + hb.upper_bound) / 2 FROM histogram_bin hb WHERE hb.histogram_chart_configuration_id = hc.id ORDER BY hb.upper_bound DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE hc.binning_mode = 'MANUAL';
